source.authority: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
source.text: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller confirmation as to whether or not personal data concerning him or her are being processed, and, where that is the case, access to the personal data and the following information: (a) the purposes of the processing; (b) the categories of personal data concerned; (c) the recipients or categories of recipient; (d) the envisaged storage period; (e) the existence of the right to request rectification, erasure, restriction, or object; (f) the right to lodge a complaint; (g) available information on the data source; (h) the existence of automated decision-making including profiling. [...] The controller shall provide a copy of the personal data undergoing processing.

deploymentNotes: At deployment: 'structure' resolves to the data controller. 'purpose' resolves to data subjects. Enables the right of access. Norms verify that access requests are fulfilled within the Art 12(3) deadline.
